evidence: In failed runs (e.g., c8t17_s69078927), collision occurred while robot was moving (0.41 m/s) with mover within 1m and positive closing speed (0.35 m/s)
Evasion trigger requires st_n >= 0.1m, but in narrow passages (st_n < 0.1m) evasion is disabled, causing no evasion action when movers approach
Mover detected within 2m at t=18.35s, collision at 22.733s; TTC likely <1.0s before collision, but evasion not triggered due to low static clearance

assumptions.assumption: Evasion should only trigger when static clearance (st_n) is sufficient (≥0.1m) to avoid static obstacles during evasion
assumptions.why: Narrow passages are common; disabling evasion there causes collisions when movers approach

assumptions.assumption: Static clearance check (st_n) reliably indicates safe evasion zones
assumptions.why: In narrow paths, st_n <0.1m but robot can still evade safely using lateral movement if mover is detected early

approach_families.result: 5/8 passes but 3/8 fails consistently in narrow passages

candidates.idea: Remove st_n >= _EV_TRIG_ST from evasion trigger, activate based on TTC alone
candidates.for: Evasion disabled in low-clearance zones; _choose already ensures static safety via stc checks
candidates.risk: May trigger evasion in extremely tight spaces, but _choose filters unsafe candidates

candidates.idea: Use closing speed threshold (e.g., >0.1 m/s) instead of TTC for evasion trigger
candidates.for: High closing speed indicates imminent collision regardless of static clearance
candidates.risk: May trigger evasion too early in static-dense areas

candidates.idea: In st_n <0.1m zones, reduce evade speed instead of full stop
candidates.for: Allows cautious movement in narrow paths while avoiding movers
candidates.risk: Slowdown may not prevent collision if mover is fast

diagnosis.chosen: Remove st_n >= _EV_TRIG_ST from evasion trigger, as _choose already enforces static safety via stc checks and narrow passages are common failure zones
diagnosis.direction: Remove the static clearance check (st_n >= _EV_TRIG_ST) from the evasion trigger condition. This activates evasion based solely on TTC < 1.0s, ensuring mover avoidance in narrow passages. The _choose function already filters candidates with sufficient static clearance (stc ≥ 0), so evasion remains safe. Adjust evasion end conditions to prioritize distance increase over static clearance when st_n is low. Increase mover detection radius to 3.0m for earlier TTC calculation. Cap evasion duration at t + 1.0s instead of _EVADE_MAX when st_n < 0.1m. Prioritize lateral movement when movers are within 1.0m–2.0m during evasion.
